description: This file is a Django management command that generates an OpenAPI schema in JSON format by invoking drf_yasg's schema view and writing the output to a file named 'openapi.json' inside an 'interfaces' directory.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: A Django management command class that generates and saves an OpenAPI schema JSON file.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Generates the OpenAPI schema by invoking the schema view, renders the response, parses the JSON content, creates the output directory, and saves the schema to a file.
